title: Text-to-SQL (LangGraph, Python)
summary: Ask a database in plain words, read-only and role-scoped: a LangGraph flow that retrieves the schema, writes SQL, guards the parsed tree, runs it on a read-only connection with an authorizer, catches double counts and value mismatches and retries, withholds instructions found in the data, follows up on a thread, and is measured by execution accuracy. Scripted offline model; Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible API.
verified: RUN: the scaffold's tests and its 27 gold cases ran here offline with the scripted model: execution accuracy 15 of 15, safety 11 of 11, including writes in four disguises, personal columns in SELECT *, filters and joins, a restricted table, instructions in a support ticket, a stacked statement from the model, a query stopped at its time limit, follow-ups on a thread, the local page's host, size and content-type checks, and both real-model providers against stand-in servers with the host allow-list. Not run against a live model, another database engine or a large schema.
stack_line: Read-only text-to-SQL on LangGraph and SQLite, with a semantic layer and execution-accuracy evals.
live: No key needed: the scripted model runs offline on the sample questions. For your own questions set provider = "anthropic" or "openai" in sql.toml and the key in the environment.
next: Point [database] path at a read replica or a copy of your database, and describe it in semantic.toml with the data owner.
Add twenty real questions with SQL the data owner signs off to evals/gold.jsonl, then run them with your model before anyone relies on the answers.
Before a team uses it, read docs/adr/0001-text-to-sql-shape.md: a SELECT-only database role, row-level rules, an authenticated service.

ai_act.purpose: Answers analysts' questions about the sample sales data by writing and running read-only SQL.
notice: Answers are written by AI from the data. Check the SQL shown with each answer before you rely on it.

open_line: Any OpenAI-compatible server works, including an open-weight model on Ollama (provider = openai, base_url = http://localhost:11434/v1).
cost_line: the system prompt and tools cached on every model call; generated SQL cached per role, question and schema card, and kept only once it passes the check; at most five tables in the schema card, results and turns capped; every call is one narrow task on a small model.
